Safe metadata:
`{details}`

The output contains only sanitized protocol metadata. Passwords, authenticator codes, account IDs, bizToken values, authorizeCode values, session tokens and raw VeSync responses are never included. Copy only these safe metadata lines.
result.title: VeSync authentication probe result

data_description.api_region: Use EU for accounts handled by the European VeSync service. Use GLOBAL for the US and other non-EU regions.
data_description.country_code: Two-letter ISO country code for the VeSync account, for example HU, DE, GB or US.
data_description.otp_code: Enter a fresh current numeric code from your authenticator app immediately before submitting. It is used only during this one run and is never stored.
data_description.password: Used only inside this diagnostic run. Plaintext is not stored by the probe.
data_description.username: Email address used by the VeSync account. It is not stored by the probe.

user.description: Version 0.7 uses a single form to avoid the multi-step form error seen in 0.6. Enter all five values once. After VeSync returns the MFA challenge, the probe automatically tries up to 15 bounded OTP request shapes using only VeSync's two already-known authentication endpoints. It stops immediately on success, rate limiting, account lock, or an explicit invalid/expired-code response. The built-in VeSync integration is not changed.
user.title: Run VeSync 2FA single-pass probe
